description: This file defines a DenseNet backbone for RetinaNet object detection models, including utility functions for model creation, pre-trained weight downloading, and validation.

classes.name: DenseNetBackbone
classes.description: Class representing a DenseNet backbone with methods for model retrieval, weight download, validation, and image preprocessing.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Constructs a RetinaNet model using a DenseNet backbone with specified parameters.

methods.name: download_imagenet
methods.description: Downloads pre-trained ImageNet weights for the specified DenseNet backbone.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the backbone string is among the allowed options.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Preprocesses an input image for the DenseNet model.
